fixture_findings.title: Direct fetch of user-controlled URL enables SSRF
fixture_findings.recommendation: Restore server-side destination validation before fetching, such as the previous allowlist-based helper, and reject non-approved schemes/hosts/IP ranges. If previews must support broader URLs, add strict SSRF defenses: parse and canonicalize the URL, allow only http/https, resolve and block private/link-local/loopback ranges, and enforce redirects and DNS rebinding protections.

fixture_findings.title: Path traversal: unsanitized name written outside UPLOAD_DIR

fixture_findings.title: No timeout: a slow or blackholed host hangs the worker

fixture_findings.title: Unbounded response body read into memory
